## zipzi.values.ExportSettings

```python
class ExportSettings(Value)
```

Cubism output policy. A model unit corresponds to one canvas pixel; PPU
converts those lengths into Cubism runtime units only at the file boundary.

| Field | Type | Constructor default (wire JSON) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pixels_per_unit` | `float` | Required | Positive model-length to Cubism-runtime-unit conversion scale at the file boundary;<br>model units themselves remain canvas-pixel lengths. |
| `bounds` | `tuple[float, ...] \| None` | `null` (`None`) | Optional stable rectangle [left, bottom, right, top] in model units.<br>Specified bounds bypass automatic padding; pixel edges round outwards. |
| `padding_fraction` | `float` | Required | Fractional export padding relative to the frame extent; dimensionless. |
| `padding_pixels` | `float` | Required | Additional export padding measured in pixels. |
| `minimum_extent` | `float` | Required | Finite nonnegative minimum automatic export extent in model units; native default is 256. |

<a id="zipzi-values-warpbeziereditmode"></a>

## zipzi.values.WarpBezierEditMode

```python
class WarpBezierEditMode(StrEnum)
```

Editor influence semantics, independent of runtime Warp interpolation.

| Member | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `LOCAL` | `'local'` | Edit explicit controls; anchors carry their own handles. |
| `SMOOTH_LOCAL` | `'smooth_local'` | Cosine influence on nearby nodes within two controller cells. |
| `SMOOTH_GLOBAL` | `'smooth_global'` | Gaussian influence across normalized controller coordinates. |
| `PRESERVE_STRUCTURE` | `'preserve_structure'` | Couple opposite handles while preserving their length ratio; anchors stay fixed. |
